description: Nightly decision-consolidation job (sibling of aios-consolidation.timer ~03:03): sample logged /decide decisions - confident AND borderline - through qwen-27B as audit oracle; refit isotonic/temperature calibration; auto-tune abstain thresholds against error budget; emit disagreement report + high-value exemplars for S1 prompt injection (eventual distillation input). Wrap with ai-power-manager active --ttl. Requires >=100 logged pairs accumulated from 02/03 before first meaningful run - install early, expect thin data initially.
